Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected complete portrait card. Image1 exact rejected raw full-resolution editing target. Image2 unchanged original game card controls exact PRIMARY hair/clothes/leftward pose/roll/crop/light. Image3 literal mascot identity/compact rounded anatomy only. Correct ONLY elongated pointed lower yellow head and source collar contact. Current face descends well below grey mouth and tapers into a low chin tip immediately over blue bow. Remove entire low point and shorten mouth-to-chin distance substantially, forming a very SHALLOW SHORT BROAD ROUNDED U lower arc CLOSE below mouth, one COMPACT NEAR-ROUND head, never egg-shaped human jaw or V. Raise/broaden actual pale shirt collar contact immediately beneath rounded base, minimal very short broad transition, coherent fabric overlap and contact shadow. Preserve exact PRIMARY IMAGE-LEFT moderate three-quarter turn/roll, no frontal rotation. Keep literal LARGE GREEN-RINGED BLACK creature eyes/simple small GREY CLOSED mouth/smooth yellow anatomy without human nose/lips/wrinkles. Retain uncovered SHORT LIGHT BLOND/BROWN neat side-parted swept-back hair/receding temple edge/real LIGHT brow HAIR/CLEAN upper lip/chin. OPEN BLACK/NAVY jacket/PALE pointed shirt/BLUE SHORT BOW with LATERAL WINGS; no red/blue long tie, gold lapel pin, cap, glasses, medals or new beard. Keep OPAQUE BLUE-GREY backing/full tilted dark rim/cream lower-right note overlap. All solids opaque, genuine alpha only outside whole-card silhouette; tiny marks understated. No low point/V throat/shaft/pinched or floating collar/clipping/cream bib or invented writing.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
